name: CreditFlow
title: CreditFlow: Dependency-Aware Credit Assignment for Multi-Step Tool-Using Agents
subtitle: Credit assignment for tool-using agents
details: Proposed artifact-based credit attribution as the core contribution: treating intermediate artifacts as the fundamental unit for assigning credit in tool-using agent trajectories
Designed CreditFlow framework representing rollouts as auditable artifact dependency graphs with explicit producer-consumer links
Decomposed training feedback into local transition quality, responsibility transfer for upstream errors, and path-based terminal credit through validated dependency paths
Achieves 9.1% average improvement over AgentFlow (ICLR 2026 Oral) while reducing inference steps by 28.6% across 8 benchmarks

name: LEAT
title: LEAT: LLM-Guided Experience-Aware Adaptive Tuning for MIP Solver Configuration
subtitle: Experience-aware solver configuration
details: Designed and implemented a hierarchical experience repository that summarizes similar historical tuning trials into high-level nodes
Built graph construction and hierarchical retrieval mechanisms for efficient LLM-guided experience lookup
Outperforms default configuration with over 70% win rate across all tested datasets in one-shot setting
Achieves stronger early-stage and final performance under iterative tuning with only 40%—60% of the evaluation budget
Framework deployed in industrial applications; a national invention patent has been filed

name: ASC26
title: ASC26 Supercomputing Competition — World Model Acceleration
subtitle: World model acceleration
details: Member of HPC Team SwanGeese of USTC; accelerated UniFoLM-WMA-0 world model (developed by Unitree Robotics) on 4×8 A100 node
Implemented high-level feature caching for diffusion models (inspired by DeepCache, CVPR 2024)
Combined cross-attention KV cache optimization with parallel execution strategies
Achieved 3.7× speedup over baseline while preserving output quality

name: AndroidAgentRuntime
title: AndroidAgentRuntime
subtitle: On-device intelligence for Android
details: Designing an on-device LLM agent framework for Android that operates mobile devices through low-level system API understanding
Built a lightweight system interaction layer optimized for LLM comprehension
Ported high-throughput LLM deployment tools (similar to vLLM) to Android via Vulkan API for GPU inference
